Asymmetric coarse fur masses and a blunt unfamiliar animal face create an original silhouette; not a werewolf, gorilla, demon or any known franchise monster. Head, gaze, chest and claws face LEFT. Its broad mass reads larger than reference humans while fitting the same square asset format; silhouette approximately y=25 to y=485 on the final 512 canvas. Background has no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane or lighting variation. Solid opaque silhouette with crisp ink edges; no stray ink specks, cast or contact shadow.
Constraints: original design only; do not imitate any existing game, franchise creature or artist. No text, logos, watermark, border, UI or other subjects. Deliver ONE separate square image, not a sheet or collage.
